# Wood arrow

Internal ID: ArrowWood | Type: Arrow | Source: Workbench | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Wood x8

# Introduction

Wood arrows are the first arrows, available once the workbench has been created.

## Notes

• They are the only arrows that do not require feathers to craft, which can useful even into the midgame.

Categorias: Weapons, Arrows, Workbench recipes
